subject: Request: Short pilot extension while supplier onboarding completes

From: Sara Liu <sara.liu@medwavehealth.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@medwavehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 08:06:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot hold — asking for a short extension

Hi Diego,

Quick note from the MedWave side — our supplier onboarding (security questionnaire and SOC evidence) got pushed back by Legal and the vendor integrations team. Procurement says PO approval will now slip by another two weeks. We still want to proceed with the Redwood pilot; the engineering team is mid-integration and we don't want momentum to stall.

Could you hold the sandbox for us and possibly extend our trial window by ~14 days so the team can finish testing once the PO clears? If you need a purchase intent note or an internal contact, I can get a short confirmation from our Head of Procurement (cc'd).

Really appreciate any flexibility here — happy to jump on a 15-min call if that's easier.

Thanks,
Sara Liu
Senior Product Manager
MedWave Health
[sara.liu@medwavehealth.com]

Sara —

Thanks for the heads up and for the clear timeline. Short answer: yes, we can keep the sandbox live and extend the trial for 14 days while procurement finishes the PO. I want to confirm internally for the promotional credit side (we usually handle trial top-ups as a one-time voucher for stalled procurements).

Marissa / Monica — can you approve a 2,000 USD trial credit voucher to bridge MedWave while their PO clears? MedWave is engaged and has engineering hours invested; procurement delay is the blocker. If approved, I can issue the voucher and note the agreement in HubSpot.

Sara — if your procurement team can drop a quick note confirming the PO is in-flight (even a one-line email), that helps our reconciliation. Also copying a short usage guideline for the voucher if approved.

Best,
